limitations: Selected visual review only; unviewed images retain producer review and are not independently approved here.
Conceptual scene/prop continuity checks do not validate engine navigation, collision, mechanical safety or native animation.
Empty staging and separate props do not establish consent, paid accounts, legal import, available inventory or resolved quests.

findings.finding: Two distinct ritual tables, clear water trough and passage between tables are visible; no merged rite, shared celebrants, corpse or authoritative religious conclusion is depicted. Secular aid room has its own street approach, closed chest, three separate tied packets and an unopened parcel, so aid need not be reached through either ritual. Left panel clearly shows one common front entrance; the second independent street-side approach required by the prompt is not clearly established. Map layout must allow either table to be reached without crossing the other’s ritual space. The candle tip is yellow and its unlit state is ambiguous at review scale, so do not treat the manifest’s unlit claim as verified. Empty chairs/packets do not certify rite choice, paid assistance or donor absolution.

Prominent open shipping box is visibly empty, with its tag outside it; local armor parts sit on a separate table. No received cargo, customs clearance, harbor or legal-import approval is shown. The left yard has a clear front opening, but four-way courtyard access is not demonstrated by the surrounding streets: rear shelving/walls and side furnishings interrupt direct passage. Right room has two open front-corner exits, a screened waiting corner, closed drawer and three distinct trays/closed packets. One packet bears a small decorative seal, which must not be read as signature, paid receipt or approval. Separate wage, injury and sponsorship accounts must remain distinct actual transactions; decoration supplies no funds or new inventory.

overall: Selected aid/obligation boards preserve independent accounts and no forced reconciliation. Independent ritual approaches and four-way inspection-yard circulation remain unresolved.
